description: Frontend / UI personas — multi-persona browser audit with isolated BrowserContext per persona (zero cross-persona contamination), a11y pass, every reported bug re-validated. Phase 4 personas drive via browser_* only (Principe 10).

gates.name: ui.coverageRatio
gates.description: Methodology Principe 10 — Phase-4 personas drive the target via browser_* only. Hard fail at <50%, warning <70%. Per-persona waiver via UI-EXEMPT: <persona>: <reason> in retrospective.toolingFeedback.

gates.name: a11y.criticalViolations
gates.description: Zero axe-core 'critical' or 'serious' violations on the personas' visited pages. Record under metric `a11y.criticalViolations` (cumulative count across all personas).

gates.name: personas.contextIsolation
gates.description: Every Phase-4 persona must call browser_new_context at start of run. Record under metric `personas.uncontaminated` (count of personas that called browser_new_context) and `personas.declared` (total persona count).

gates.name: claims.validatedRatio
gates.description: Every reported bug must have been re-validated by claim-validator before clôture. claims.validated / claims.reported = 1.0.
